title: Placement
description: Which empty part of osu!'s screen the dial uses. auto: osu! right of the playfield, mania left of the stage, taiko centred below the lane. left/right: the other side of the playfield or stage (osu! left sits under the leaderboard); in taiko, the left or right end of the area below the lane.

title: Nudge X / px
description: Moves the dial right (negative: left) from its placement, for skins that move the playfield, stage or HUD.

title: Nudge Y / px
description: Moves the dial down (negative: up) from its placement.

title: Scale / %
description: Dial size, 50–150 %. 100 % fits the free space of the placement in osu!'s default layout (e.g. the ~300 px left of a stable mania stage); go above it when your skin leaves more room.

title: Backing
description: none floats the dial on the game with a soft shade under the arc only; scrim adds a soft fading disc of shade; panel draws the 18-LAB graphite panel.

title: Accent
description: Needle and mean-marker colour: the current map's tonal accent (from its background, never shown), or 18-LAB amber. Judgement and early/late colours never change.

title: Arc sweep / °
description: How far the dial wraps around its centre, 90–270°. 180° is a half circle; wider sweeps spread the windows over more arc.

title: Tick lifetime / s
description: How long each hit's tick stays on the arc before it has faded out, 0.5–20 s.

title: Show histogram
description: Distribution of recent hits, drawn as a stepped profile around the outside of the arc.

title: Histogram hits
description: How many of the most recent hits the histogram counts, 50–2000.

title: Needle average / hits
description: The needle shows the mean of this many recent hits, 5–200. The small caret on the band is the whole attempt's mean.
